rules.name: Business Logic — Price Manipulation
rules.description: Detects price manipulation attempts via negative quantities, zero-price items, or modified totals in checkout
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "business" or Message contains "logic" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG10-001

rules.name: Business Logic — Rate Limit Bypass
rules.description: Detects API rate limit bypass attempts using header manipulation, IP rotation, or parameter tampering
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "business" or Message contains "logic" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG10-002

rules.name: Business Logic — Workflow Bypass
rules.description: Detects attempts to skip workflow steps or access later stages without completing prerequisites
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "business" or Message contains "logic" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG10-003

rules.name: Business Logic — Negative Quantity or Amount
rules.description: Detects transactions with negative quantities or amounts indicating business logic bypass
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "business" or Message contains "logic" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG10-004

rules.name: Error Handling — Verbose Error Information Disclosure
rules.description: Detects verbose error responses containing stack traces, database details, or internal paths
rules.query: AzureDiagnostics | where Category contains 'error_handling' | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), resource_group | where count_ > 5

rules.name: Cryptography — Weak Hash Algorithm Usage
rules.description: Detects usage of weak hash algorithms (MD5, SHA1) in application transactions or certificate signatures
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "cryptography" or Message contains "weak" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG10-006

rules.name: Data Classification — PII in Logs
rules.description: Detects PII data (SSN, credit card, email) appearing in application logs in cleartext
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "data" or Message contains "classification" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG10-007

rules.name: Data Classification — Unencrypted Data at Rest
rules.description: Detects storage of sensitive data without encryption at rest in databases, file systems, or object stores
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent | where Message contains "data" or Message contains "classification" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer | where count_ > 5 // AZ-WSTG10-008
